title: Essay-Outline as the RESEARCH Artifact Form
summary: The RESEARCH artifact is an Essay-Outline with four sections (Abstract, Argument-Graph, Citation-Embedded Outline, References); the form change applies going forward with no retroactive migration, so the essay corpus mixes forms.

links.note: ADR-099 §Authority option C follows this ADR's no-retroactive-migration precedent: the record form applies to units authored after the ADR and the corpus mixes forms
one of the six prior audience-bifurcation ADRs (research-artifact form); complete answer to its own problem under the alternative reading
